scope: Three separate validation layers: packet-limited LIPM, swing-constrained DCM planning, and torque-driven planar articulated biped. Not a single integrated robot stack.

sensor.warm_start: One noisy frame before start; no perfect current-state fallback
sensor.ordering: Only strictly newer generation timestamps accepted
sensor.stale_policy: Stop model propagation once source age exceeds configured threshold; this is not a hardware stop verification

gait.timing_commit: At most one timing decision per phase after significant DCM error; positions may continue to adjust
gait.swing_continuity: C2 piecewise quintic; exact component extrema provide conservative continuous norm bounds
gait.double_support: CoP projected to convex hull of both soles; nonnegative load split with individual CoPs within soles is reconstructed
gait.success: All nine exchanges, terminal distance to actual support <2cm, speed<0.08m/s, no earlier admissibility failure

biped.foot_velocity_constraint: Inscribed regular octagon at next control sample
biped.contact_force_actuation: QP wrenches are predictions only; simulator receives joint torques, gravity and explicitly configured push
biped.landing_verification: For each planned side: x error<2.5cm, |sole z|<8mm, measured ground Fz>10N continuously>=15ms within [-40,+100]ms of planned touchdown
biped.walking_success: Full horizon, all eight verified landings, forward progress>=planned minus10cm, terminal foot error<4cm, no tilt/height/QP/velocity guard
biped.observation: Ideal full-state feedback; packet/noise tests above are not yet connected to this controller
biped.geometry: Planar sagittal model, lateral translation/roll/yaw constrained; torso/link collisions simplified
biped.solver: OSQP 1.0.4 builtin, fixed adaptive-rho interval; no hard realtime claim
